summary: Cited the repeat of the bound experiment (receipt 962196ed81fd46cfb9476bbd63c2c637) in the replay-completion account: it reproduces the below-bound and above-bound cases with identical operands - events 23 and 25 record 1501 replayed entries with 94 batches and a return in 0ms, events 27 and 29 record 3001 entries with 188 batches and no return with the replay frames in the stack - so the only differing operand across the two executions is the flag-off control's return latency (5ms and 3ms). Every pair in the account now has at least two executions: the 9000-entry pair two, the bound pair two, the boundary pair two, the default-configuration pair two and the availability pair three. The schedule-variation limitation is corrected to say so, joint_history records that this receipt is the same fixed experiment executed again rather than a separate producer, and the account now cites nine receipts for the replay question; the configuration-recovery account continues to cite six.
